Projects

Live sites first, then open-source tools grouped by what they are for. The code for the tools is on GitHub.

Live sites

  • glottosphere.com

    A free multilingual dictionary where every word in a definition is a link, with profiles of thousands of the world's languages.

Language

    Turns one word into a looping GIF of its translations in 80+ languages.

  • readme_rosetta

  • polyglot-poster

    Turns photos of a French textbook into a wall poster in six languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, French and Korean.

    Vulgar Latin in reverse: a Romance conlang optimized with simulated annealing.
